summary: AVAX trading shows a clear directional bias toward LONG entries in strong trending conditions (ADX >= 35 with DI+ gap >= 5), which achieve 75% win rates. Weak trends (ADX < 25) are a major loss driver with only 20% win rate on LONGs. The DNE signal system is excessively conservative, missing 70% of winning opportunities; recommend recalibration to capture more high-ADX setups.
